subject.title: feat(secrets): expose degraded owners to operators

question: Should OpenClaw make the proposed redacted `secrets.degraded[]` owner inventory a supported Gateway/operator contract in addition to the legacy flat field?
rationale: The implementation is additive and has real behavior proof, but it permanently defines what secret-runtime degradation metadata is exposed to operators and downstream status consumers.

options.title: Approve the nested contract
options.body: Accept the typed redacted owner inventory after the responsible secret-runtime/security review confirms the exposed fields and long-term compatibility commitment.

options.title: Keep the current flat status surface
options.body: Decline the new public inventory for now and preserve the existing degraded-owner reporting until a narrower contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve the nested contract
recommendation.body: Accept the typed redacted owner inventory after the responsible secret-runtime/security review confirms the exposed fields and long-term compatibility commitment.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged degraded-owner foundation that this PR extends and are the clearest feature-history routing candidate.
